name: FPE:S [🎃]
desc:
* EPILEPSY WARNING: CONTAINS LOUD AUDIO & FLASHING IMAGERY *
FPE:S (Fundamental Paper Education: Survival) is an 3v22 survival game based on the "Basics in Behavior" FPE short created by Katie/A3DGhost.

STUDENTS: Survive the night and fend off Teachers using books & shop items. 
TEACHERS: Kill the failures.
ALICE: Unleash your fury by killing Students (even Teachers) and unlock your full potential.
